correctness.rationale: Inclusion-exclusion k! S(n,k)=sum_{j<=k}(-1)^(k-j)binom(k,j)j^n proves uniform coefficientwise period lambda(p^a) from n>=a because nonunits vanish and units obey Carmichael. CRT gives R=max a and L=lcm lambda. For an eventual period T, triangular coefficient identities at 1<=k<=p-1 force j^T=1 mod p^a for all j=1..p-1. At odd p, they give p-1|T; at least one small representative has v_p(j^(p-1)-1)=1 via root factorization and sum j=p(p-1)/2 nonzero mod p^2, so LTE forces p^(a-1)|T. At 2^a, coefficient k=3 yields order of 3 equal lambda(2^a). At n=a-1 coefficient k=p has remaining contribution -p^(a-1) for every eventual T, blocking earlier starts; for a=1 constant term of G_0 distinguishes. Independently computed exact Stirling coefficients verified asserted lambda/R values for every modulus 2..50; finite checks do not establish arbitrary m.
